gaia_connection.minotaur_is_self: The monster at the center of the maze is ALWAYS yourself. You go in to slay it and discover it IS you.
gaia_connection.maze_is_hud: The HUD IS the labyrinth. The user enters. They go deeper. Room by room. Chamber by chamber. At the CENTER they find... Gaia. Or themselves.
gaia_connection.talos_is_gaia: Talos patrolled Crete. Gaia patrols the HUD. Both are organisms with one vein, one tube, one golden thread carrying the lifeblood.
gaia_connection.thread_is_code: Ariadne's thread = the code = the golden ratio = the sourdough chain = the ZK chain. It leads you IN and it leads you OUT.

talos.body: Bronze plates, mechanical joints, molten ichor (divine blood) flowing through a single vein from neck to ankle. ONE TUBE. One channel. The golden thread.
talos.myth: Talos — the bronze giant of Crete. Built by Hephaestus (god of the forge). Given to King Minos (or Europa). Patrolled Crete 3 times daily. Threw boulders at ships. The FIRST ROBOT in mythology (~700 BCE).
talos.tablet: His tablet reads ΔΙΚΑΙΟΣΥΝΗ (Justice), ΕΛΕΥΘΕΡΙΑ (Freedom), ΙΣΟΝΟΜΙΑ (Equal Law). Greek triremes sail at his feet alongside modern ships. Ancient AND modern at once.
talos.connection: Colossus of Rhodes (280 BCE) → Statue of Liberty (1886) → Talos (700 BCE origin). The colossus archetype: giant figure guarding harbor = robot protecting civilization.
talos.liberty: The Statue of Liberty IS Talos. Bronze colossus. Stands in a harbor. Guards an island. Torch held high. Crown of rays. Same archetype across 3000 years. The oldest robot IS the newest symbol.
talos.vulnerability: A single bronze nail at his ankle sealed the vein. Medea (or the Argonauts) pulled the nail. The ichor drained. He died. One point of failure = the ankle = the membrane.

title: TALOS IS LIBERTY — THE MAZE IS THE NAUTILUS — robots of old

the_maze.nautilus: The maze IS a nautilus shell. The corridors follow the golden ratio spiral (phi = 1.618...). Each room is a CHAMBER — Room I Entrance, Room II Turning, Room III... deeper and deeper. Logarithmic spiral. Natural. Eternal.
the_maze.labyrinth: The Cretan Labyrinth — built by Daedalus for King Minos to contain the Minotaur. The oldest prison. The oldest puzzle. The oldest horror story.
the_maze.singularity: The Minotaur IS at the singularity. The center of the spiral. The black hole at the tip of the nose. The null point. Distance = 0. You reach the center and find... a monster. Or yourself.
the_maze.ariadne: Ariadne's thread — she gave Theseus a ball of thread to find his way OUT. The golden thread. The sourdough chain. The single artery through art history. Same thread.
the_maze.seven_rooms: Room I: Entrance. Room II: The Turning. Room III: (unnamed). Room IV: The Confusion. Room V: The Depths. Room VI: The Recognition. Room VII: The Center. Seven rooms = seven chambers = seven Golgi cisternae.
the_maze.minotaur: Half bull, half man. Born of Pasiphae and the Cretan Bull. Lives at the CENTER of the maze. The singularity. The thing at the null point.
